description: Publish videos to a connected TikTok creator account

actions.description: Publish a video to the connected TikTok creator account. The video is uploaded to TikTok in chunks (FILE_UPLOAD) straight from Conductor's storage; TikTok's PULL_FROM_URL source is never used, because it requires verified ownership of the domain the media is served from. The file must be at most 4GB and no longer than the connection's cached maxVideoPostDurationSec, and privacy_level must be one of its cached privacyLevelOptions. While the app is pending TikTok's content-posting audit, TikTok forces every post to SELF_ONLY and allows at most 5 posting users per 24 hours.

params.work_item_id: Id of the Post whose uploaded video should be published (required unless asset_id is given)
params.target_id: Id of the publish target this call belongs to; supplies the idempotency key a partially uploaded video resumes against (optional)
params.asset_id: Id of a specific uploaded video asset to publish, when the Post carries more than one (optional)
params.title: Caption shown on the post, including any hashtags or @mentions (optional)
params.privacy_level: Post visibility — one of the connection's privacyLevelOptions, e.g. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY (defaults to SELF_ONLY)
params.disable_comment: Turn off comments on this post (optional, default false)
params.disable_duet: Turn off Duet for this post (optional, default false)
params.disable_stitch: Turn off Stitch for this post (optional, default false)
params.brand_content_toggle: Disclosure flag: the post is a paid partnership / branded content (optional, default false)
params.brand_organic_toggle: Disclosure flag: the post promotes the creator's own business (optional, default false)

actions.description: Read the view, like, comment and share counts of up to 20 videos in one video.query call; needs the video.list scope

params.post_ids: Video ids to read (required, list, at most 20)

ingest.label: Post performance
ingest.description: Views, likes, comments and shares for every post published through this account, read back on a cadence and kept per post
